Hi

I'm Stephen, I'm working at JLR Company in Germany as Chief Architect, I need to setup a new ECU for 3 OEMs (names cannot be disclosed).
My email address is carl.mcconor@me.com, phone is +3364545780.
We need to setup a new ECU for ADAS based on NXP S32G399 with MCAL version RTD5.0, and compiler GH version v2021.5
We need multicore support for executing BSW modules , about communication we have only CAN bus with support of partial networking, we don't use any other buses, only one CAN transceiver, hardware not yet identified
We want a license model (certainly a product line license type is suitable), no royalty
the project shall comply with ASIL-D level, we don't need Fail operational feature, AUTOSAR version 4.4 is required
HSM will be required with a Secure Boot, a Bootloader is required with a boot updater, SW update strategy is flash bootloader, No V2G
2 years of developments, 1st vehicle SOP date is Q3 2028, RFM date is Q1 2028, SOD is Q3 2025, FC 26/05/2026, ECU SOP July 2027
no LTS and no cyber security maintenance are required.
We need 20 seats for tresos studio tooling, in floating license with subscription
The PI must be got by end of the week.

Thank you
Carl

New opportunity: (Competitor entry is mandatory when the opportunity is closed)
- A new project
